episodes.title: Dungeons & Dragons: The Queen's Cradle
episodes.summary: On the hunt for a dragon cult, a band of adventurers rescues a boy who's haunted by a sinister force.

episodes.title: Sifu: It Takes a Life
episodes.summary: A young martial artist bent on revenge learns the true cost of his obsession.

episodes.title: New World: The Once and Future King
episodes.summary: A conquering king washes ashore on a mysterious island with no army and no clue. He may need an eternity to find his purpose.

episodes.title: Unreal Tournament: Xan
episodes.summary: After revolting against their corporate overlords, a group of mining robots is condemned to fight for survival in deadly arena combat.

episodes.title: Warhammer 40,000: And They Shall Know No Fear
episodes.summary: In the grim darkness of the far future, a genetically-engineered warrior who has served on the front lines for centuries confronts his legacy, as his squad hunts down a mutant sorcerer.

episodes.title: PAC-MAN: Circle
episodes.summary: Trapped in a vast maze and pursued by ghosts, a mysterious entity summons a warrior to help it escape.

episodes.title: Crossfire: Good Conflict
episodes.summary: As a looming storm approaches, two rival mercenary groups collide. Driven by their vision of the greater good, the sides face off, their lives hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: Armored Core: Asset Management
episodes.summary: In a frostbitten frontier world, a legendary mech pilot learns his latest mission might hold the key to the demons that have haunted him for decades.

episodes.title: The Outer Worlds: The Company We Keep
episodes.summary: An orphan from a galactic backwater crosses the cosmos to take a job at a ruthless mega-corporation in the hopes of reuniting with the girl he loves.

episodes.title: Mega Man: Start
episodes.summary: As the corrupted creations of genius inventor Dr. Light rampage through Mega City, the humblest of his inventions dreams of fighting for everlasting peace.

episodes.title: Exodus: Odyssey
episodes.summary: A mechanic traverses the galactic frontier, racing against time in search of his runaway daughter.

episodes.title: Spelunky: Tally
episodes.summary: A pair of explorers ponder their purpose in a subterranean world where everything wants to kill them. Repeatedly.

episodes.title: Concord: Tale of the Implacable
episodes.summary: Captain Cassidy's crew of Freegunners is about to pull off the biggest heist of their lives - now there's only a deadly armada and a cosmos-sundering space storm between them and freedom.

episodes.title: Honor of Kings: The Way of All Things
episodes.summary: An orphaned prodigy challenges the all-knowing artificial intelligence that rules his city.

episodes.title: Playtime: Fulfillment
episodes.summary: Courier O is stuck in the endless drudgery of a point-chasing grind, but when a mysterious figure entrusts her with a strange package, O discovers that powerful people are determined to get their hands on it.
